newsitem.title: UK: Barclays raises base rate to 6.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Barclays raises base rate to 6.0 pct.

text.p: Barclays Bank said it has raised its base lending rate by 1/4 point to six pct in the wake of a similar increase in official rates by the Bank of England.
Bank of England governor Eddie George said the rate rise was to moderate the accelerating pace of Britain's economic upswing.
Barclays' move was later followed by National Westminster Bank but mortgage lenders said they had no immediate plans to raise their home loan rates. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717.
